newsitem.title: USA: Enova PacEnt applaud FERC merger review.
newsitem.headline: Enova PacEnt applaud FERC merger review.

text.p: Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises in a joint statement Wednesday praised the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission's (FERC) timely approval of their planned $5.2 billion merger.

"We are very pleased that the FERC approved our merger based on its merits, and in a manner consistent with its new policy guidelines and its commitment to speed up the merger review process," said Richard Farman, Pacific Enterprise chief operating officer.
The FERC decision included several conditions to mitigate vertical power concerns, but resolution of most of these was deferred to the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC).

"In our application filings with both the FERC and CPUC, we have committed to a number of safeguards to address any market power concerns," said Bill Reed, vice president of regulatory affairs at Enova.
The companies noted the CPUC will submit the merger to a great deal of addition security.
A final decision from the CPUC is expected next March.
